programs.desc: The Pulling Guard program will revolutionize Freedom of Navigation escort operations. The program will create semi-autonomous, modular, point-defense overwatch/escort systems, and an ecosystem that commercially delivers these escort services in partnership with the Services.

programs.title: Aerial Dragnet
programs.desc: Aerial Dragnet seeks to detect multiple small Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) in complex and/or urban terrain before they are within Line-Of-Sight (LOS) of friendly assets.

programs.title: Space Power Conversion Electronics (SPCE)
programs.desc: The Space Power Conversion Electronics (SPCE) program seeks to develop highly-efficient, radiation-tolerant point of load (POL) converters for low-earth-orbit satellites.

programs.title: Big Mechanism
programs.desc: The Big Mechanism program created new approaches to automate computational intelligence applicable to diverse domains such as biology, cyber, economics, social science, and intelligence. Mastering these domains requires the capability to create abstract, causal models from massive volumes of diverse data.

programs.title: Spectrum Efficiency and Access
programs.desc: The Federal Government is working to transition large swaths of spectrum (up to 500 MHz) from Federal (DoD is the primary contributor) to civilian use for broadband telecommunications.

programs.title: Adapting Cross-domain Kill-Webs (ACK)
programs.desc: The Adapting Cross-domain Kill-Webs (ACK) program assisted military decision makers with rapidly identifying and selecting options for tasking and re-tasking assets within and across organizational boundaries.

programs.title: Computers and Humans Exploring Software Security (CHESS)
programs.desc: The Computers and Humans Exploring Software Security (CHESS) program developed technologies to enable computers and humans to reason collaboratively over software artifacts, such as source code and compiled binaries, with the goal of finding vulnerabilities more rapidly and accurately than unaided human operators.

programs.title: High Assurance Cyber Military Systems (HACMS)
programs.desc: The High Assurance Cyber Military Systems (HACMS) program developed and demonstrated technologies to secure mission-critical embedded computing systems. The DoD is making increasing use of networked computing in systems such as military vehicles, weapon systems, ground sensors, smartphones, and other communication devices.

programs.title: Social Simulation (SocialSim)
programs.desc: The Social Simulation (SocialSim) program developed computational models to simulate the future spread and evolution of information in the online environment including multiple global and regional social media platforms. The global

programs.title: Advanced Disruptive Microtechnologies Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: The Advanced Disruptive Microtechnologies Studies and Concepts examines potential opportunities to enable and accelerate the transition of advanced microsystems.

programs.title: Atmospheric Water Extraction (AWE)
programs.desc: The Atmospheric Water Extraction (AWE) program aimed to enable water harvesting directly from the atmosphere by leveraging new materials and advanced engineering and manufacturing techniques to alleviate logistical and tactical

programs.title: Turning Upcycled Waste into Novel, Sustainable Materials
programs.desc: Currently, the DoW relies on critical materials and commodity molecules, such as petroleum-, rubber- and wood- derived products, which are needed to protect and provide mobility to our warfighters in an austere, expeditionary setting.

programs.title: Combatting Anti-Microbial Resistant Pathogens
programs.desc: The Combatting Anti-Microbial Resistant Pathogens program is investigating fundamental methods for using preexisting host machinery as a technology to create medical countermeasures that degrade or deactivate pathogen targets.

programs.title: Moving Target Recognition (MTR)
programs.desc: The Moving Target Recognition (MTR) program seeks to enable the use of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) sensors to detect, track, image, and automatically recognize moving ground targets within an area of interest.

programs.title: Novel Delivery Technology for Medical Countermeasures
programs.desc: The DoW requires rapid development of medical countermeasures (MCMs) to ensure force health protection and improve our ability to respond to emerging and novel biological threats. Despite recent advancements in development of new MCMs, challenges with delivery limit their current therapeutic potential.

programs.title: Compartmentalization and Privilege Management (CPM)
programs.desc: The Compartmentalization and Privilege Management (CPM) program is developing new system frameworks, architectures, and tooling to provide fine-grained, least-privileged compartmentalization that enables prevention and containment of cyber attacks.

programs.title: Biotechnology for Challenging Environments
programs.desc: The Biotechnology for Challenging Environments program is developing novel biological solutions to enable warfighter operations in remote and extreme conditions.

programs.title: Embedded Entrepreneurship Initiative (EEI)
programs.desc: EEI pairs top technical talent from DARPA programs with experienced business leaders to accelerate the transition of breakthrough technologies to market. The program provides hands-on go-to-market support, equipping teams with the tools, expertise, and strategies needed to succeed in both government and commercial sectors.

programs.title: Next Generation Microelectronics Prototyping - Designs
programs.desc: Next Generation Microelectronics Prototyping - Designs supports the development of novel three-dimensional heterogeneous integration (3DHI) capable of being prototyped using the National Network for Next-generation Microelectronics Manufacture (N3M2).

programs.title: Urban Reconnaissance through Supervised Autonomy (URSA)
programs.desc: The Urban Reconnaissance through Supervised Autonomy (URSA) program developed and demonstrated new autonomous agents and techniques that support a Blue Force Commander in managing the complexity and ambiguity of urban spaces by rapidly identifying and discriminating among potential threats during missions ranging from minutes to hours.

programs.title: 100 Gb/s RF Backbone
programs.desc: The proliferation of video, voice, chat, and other important data-streams on the battlefield has driven a need for higher capacity, reliable, assured, and all-weather communications that are deployable on a wide range of air, ground, and maritime platforms.

programs.title: Persistent Optical Wireless Energy Relay (POWER)
programs.desc: The Persistent Optical Wireless Energy Relay (POWER) program designed, built, and validated foundational components for effective optical energy relays.

programs.title: Lunar Assay via Small Satellite Orbiter (LASSO)
programs.desc: The Lunar Assay via Small Satellite Orbiter (LASSO) program will optimize autonomous navigation and propulsion in support of advancing Space Situational Awareness capabilities in cislunar space.

programs.title: Genome Protection Technologies
programs.desc: The Genome Protection Technologies program developed a biodefense capability to control, counter, and reverse the effects of accidental or malicious misuse of gene editing technologies. This research investigated new approaches for tunable controls to enable the safe and predictable use of synthetic genes and pathways.

programs.title: ELectronics for G-band ARrays (ELGAR)
programs.desc: The ELectronics for G-band ARrays (ELGAR) program is developing the integration technologies needed to create compact, high-performance G-band (220 GHz) array front-end electronics to enable phased array antenna systems for DoW communications and sensing.

programs.title: Rapid Array Development (RAD)
programs.desc: The Rapid Array Development (RAD) program investigated utilizing an immersive electromagnetic environment to understand the effects of electronic maneuvers and develop new electronic maneuver warfare (EMW) techniques for warfighter training.

programs.title: Safe Documents (SafeDocs)
programs.desc: The Safe Documents (SafeDocs) program developed software technologies that constrain syntactic complexity in data exchange formats and improve the capability to reject invalid and maliciously crafted data in electronic documents and streaming data.

programs.title: Atomic Magnetometry for Biological Imaging In Earth's Native Terrain (AMBIIENT)
programs.desc: The Atomic Magnetometry for Biological Imaging In Earth's Native Terrain (AMBIIENT) program developed a novel magnetic sensor capable of providing high-sensitivity signal measurements in the presence of ambient magnetic fields.

programs.title: Space/Time Analysis for Cybersecurity (STAC)
programs.desc: The Space/Time Analysis for Cybersecurity (STAC) program developed techniques to detect algorithmic complexity vulnerabilities and side channel attacks in software. Historically, adversaries have exploited software implementation flaws through buffer and heap overflow attacks.

programs.title: Box Kick
programs.desc: The Box Kick program is developing a capability to engage and defeat raids of adversary subsonic cruise missiles and unmanned aerial systems at low cost while preserving more capable and expensive weapons for higher-end threats.

programs.title: Learning with Less Labeling (LwLL)
programs.desc: The Learning with Less Labeling (LwLL) program developed technology to greatly reduce the amount of labeled data required to train machine learning (ML) systems. In supervised ML, a system learns through the use of labeled training examples to recognize and categorize attributes of images, text, or speech.

programs.title: Macaroni
programs.desc: Measurement and control of the electromagnetic spectrum is a key area of research for the Department of War (DoW). Spectrum dominance requires quick and efficient control of electromagnetic radiation from low frequencies to X-rays.

programs.title: Vetting Commodity Computing Systems for the DoD (VET)
programs.desc: The Vetting Commodity Computing Systems for the DoD (VET) program developed tools and methods to uncover backdoors and other hidden malicious functionality in the software and firmware on commodity IT devices.

programs.title: Circuit Realization At Faster Timescales (CRAFT)
programs.desc: The Circuit Realization At Faster Timescales (CRAFT) program developed novel integrated circuit (IC) design flows to reduce the design and verification time required for high-performance military electronics by a factor of ten. CRAFT

programs.title: Multi-Scale Modeling
programs.desc: The Multi-Scale Modeling thrust developed advanced, multi-physics models to predict the effect of disturbances and/ or perturbations in the space environment in order to inform operational decisions based on current space environment conditions.

programs.title: Geospatial Cloud Analytics (GCA)
programs.desc: The Geospatial Cloud Analytics (GCA) program will develop technology to access and analyze global-scale, multimodal geospatial data and pilot an analytics-as-a-service business model.

programs.title: Multifunctional Materials and Structures
programs.desc: The Multifunctional Materials and Structures thrust is developing materials, materials processing, and structures that are explicitly tailored for multiple functions and/or unique mechanical properties.

programs.title: Strategic Chaos Engine for Planning, Tactics, Experimentation and Resiliency (SCEPTER)
programs.desc: The Strategic Chaos Engine for Planning, Tactics, Experimentation and Resiliency (SCEPTER) program will develop machine-generated strategies for strategic planning. SCEPTER will discover novel and surprising courses of action (CoAs) by exploring the high complexity state-action space of military engagements at high machine speeds.

programs.title: Materials for Force Protection
programs.desc: The Materials for Force Protection thrust is developing novel materials and materials systems that will greatly enhance performance against ballistic, blast, and chemical threats across the full spectrum of warfighter environments. Included

programs.title: Ouija
programs.desc: The Ouija program quantified the High Frequency (HF) noise environment in space and improved the characterization of the ionosphere in support of warfighter capabilities.

programs.title: Burn n' Go
programs.desc: The Burn n' Go program will increase the production rate and availability of solid rocket motors (SRMs) via development of novel materials and methods for tailorable, post-manufacturing thrust control.

programs.title: Diverse & Accessible Heterogeneous Integration (DAHI)
programs.desc: The Diverse Accessible Heterogeneous Integration (DAHI) program developed the design and manufacturing capabilities required to seamlessly integrate various semiconductors, microelectromechanical systems, photonic (light- manipulating) devices and thermal management structures into true systems-on-a-chip (SOC).

programs.title: Seeker Cost Transformation (SECTR)
programs.desc: The Seeker Cost Transformation (SECTR) program developed novel weapon terminal sensing and guidance technologies and systems for air-launched and air-delivered weapons that can: (1) find and acquire fixed and moving targets with only minimal external support, (2) achieve high navigation accuracy in a GPS-denied environment, and (3) be ver…

programs.title: Coho
programs.desc: The Coho program developed advanced signal processing technologies and techniques for future Radio Frequency (RF) systems.

programs.title: Signature Management using Operational Knowledge and Environments (SMOKE)
programs.desc: The Signature Management using Operational Knowledge and Environments (SMOKE) program is developing signature management technologies that generate evasive cyber infrastructure which minimizes signatures as a source of attribution.

programs.title: Thermal Imaging Technology Experiment-Recon (TITE-R)
programs.desc: The Thermal Imaging Technology Experiment-Recon (TITE-R) program developed and demonstrated complementary sensing modalities, advanced processing, and low size, weight, and power which more closely represents an objective capability.

programs.title: Hardening Development Toolchains Against Emergent Execution Engines (HARDEN)
programs.desc: The Hardening Development Toolchains Against Emergent Execution Engines (HARDEN) program is developing techniques and tools to anticipate, isolate, and mitigate emergent system behaviors and thereby improve security of complex integrated software.

programs.title: Advanced C4 Systems Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: The Advanced C4 Systems Studies and Concepts will design and demonstrate advanced communications systems and information systems technology to provide novel concepts and advanced capabilities to access challenging new environments and overcome contested domains.

programs.title: Autonomy Standards and Ideals with Military Operational Values (ASIMOV)
programs.desc: The Autonomy Standards and Ideals with Military Operational Values (ASIMOV) program developed an initial autonomy benchmarking framework to objectively and quantitatively measure the readiness of future autonomous systems and the operational complexity and difficulty of proposed use-cases in support of Military Operational Values (MOV) (e…

programs.title: Advanced Research Concepts (ARC)
programs.desc: The Advanced Research Concepts (ARC) program will rapidly explore revolutionary, nascent high-risk/high-reward ideas to accelerate the discovery of paradigm-shifting technologies.

programs.title: Series Hybrid Electric Propulsion AircRaft Demonstrator (SHEPARD)
programs.desc: The Series Hybrid Electric Propulsion AircRaft Demonstrator (SHEPARD) program designed and developed an efficient Hybrid Electric Propulsion (HEP) system and integrated it into a unique military aircraft application. The innovative aircraft design included essential operational considerations and mission system components.

programs.title: Distributed Access to Critical Biotherapeutics for Warfighters
programs.desc: The goal of the Distributed Access to Critical Biotherapeutics for Warfighters program was to ensure DoD access to critical medical countermeasures (MCMs) by establishing the foundational technologies needed for fully distributable, on-demand manufacturing of protein-based MCMs and critical reagents.

programs.title: Preventing the Emergence of Disease (PED)
programs.desc: Many emerging infectious disease outbreaks have origins in animal reservoirs and occur in areas where DoD personnel are deployed, putting them at high risk of endemic and emerging diseases.

programs.title: Fast Network Interface Cards (FastNICs)
programs.desc: The Fast Network Interface Cards (FastNICs) program created new networking technologies to accelerate the computation of distributed applications.

programs.title: Generating Communications Channels to Operate (GeCCO)
programs.desc: The Generating Communications Channels to Operate (GeCCO) program will enable secure communications for military operations in contested environments by creating communications paths that assure privacy and availability. This effort will develop advanced and flexible communication architectures that employ new virtual network services.

programs.title: BioDesign
programs.desc: BioDesign employed system engineering methods in combination with advances in biological and chemical technologies to create novel methods for threat response.

programs.title: Massive Cross Correlation (MAX)
programs.desc: The Massive Cross Correlation (MAX) program aimed to develop a scalable wideband correlator that can simultaneously achieve the state-of-the-art dynamic range of a digital correlator with the power efficiency enabled by analog electronics.

programs.title: Spectrum Collaboration Challenge (SC2)
programs.desc: The Spectrum Collaboration Challenge (SC2) program catalyzed the development of systems, called Collaborative Intelligent Radios (CIRs) that intelligently share and optimize wireless spectrum usage without prior knowledge of each other's operating characteristics.

programs.title: Restoring Cognitive Capability
programs.desc: The Restoring Cognitive Capability program developed novel drugs to provide rapid therapy for neuropsychiatric disorders experienced by warfighters and veterans. Active-duty military personnel face increased risk of acute and chronic neuropsychiatric dysfunction, limiting day-to-day function and return to duty.

programs.title: Scalable Analog Neural networks (ScAN)
programs.desc: The Scalable Analog Neural networks (ScAN) program is increasing neural network (NN) inferencing capabilities at the edge and simultaneously reducing the size, weight, and power (SWaP) needed to support inferencing on edge platforms.

programs.title: NanoWatt Platforms for Sensing, Analysis, and Computation (NaPSAC)
programs.desc: Efficient, high-speed scientific computing architectures are a ubiquitous requirement for applications including modeling of complex physical systems, advanced device designs, and multiscale computations of dynamical phenomena such as climate models or turbulence.

programs.title: Adaptive Radar Countermeasures (ARC)
programs.desc: The Adaptive Radar Countermeasures (ARC) program developed new algorithms for rapidly protecting DoD systems against new or unknown radar-based threats.

programs.title: Assessing Immune Memory (AIM)
programs.desc: Warfighter defense against pathogens is reliant on multiple vaccinations administered repeatedly to maintain effective protection. The Assessing Immune Memory (AIM) program sought to increase the longevity of infectious disease protection in warfighters by establishing tools that can be employed in new prophylactic development pipelines.

programs.title: Agile Artificial Intelligence (AgAI)
programs.desc: The Agile Artificial Intelligence (AgAI) program sought to create the capability to rapidly stand-up AI in domains important to national security.

programs.title: Business Process Logic (BPL)
programs.desc: The Business Process Logic (BPL) program is developing techniques to characterize and resolve vulnerabilities in business logic systems to protect and assure defense-critical workflows for government and business.

programs.title: Biologically Based Materials and Devices Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: The Biologically Based Materials and Devices Studies and Concepts thrust aims to enhance the DoW's capability to conduct operations in varied conditions. The DoW operates in all domains, which creates a myriad of difficult burdens to the warfighter and sustained operations.

programs.title: Microsystem Induced CAtalysis (MICA)
programs.desc: The Microsystem Induced CAtalysis (MICA) program is developing advanced concepts for microsystem control of biological function. The program seeks hardware demonstrations of molecular catalysts immobilized to microsystem surfaces so that catalyst activity is controlled by physical forces generated by the microsystem.

programs.title: Advanced Sources for Single-event Effect Radiation Testing (ASSERT)
programs.desc: 3D heterogeneously integrated (3DHI) microelectronics will be a key driver of the next wave in electronics performance. However, the nation's current single-event effect (SEE) radiation testing infrastructure lacks the ability to analyze and qualify emerging 3D devices for operation in high radiation environments.

programs.title: Analysis and Adaptation of Human Resilience
programs.desc: The Analysis and Adaptation of Human Resilience program explored new methods to maintain and optimize warfighter health in response to environmental insults such as new and emerging infectious diseases.

programs.title: Electronic Technology Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: The Electronic Technology Studies and Concepts thrust is developing technologies that can enable a new generation of integrated circuits.

programs.title: Reconfigurable Structures
programs.desc: In the Reconfigurable Structures thrust, new combinations of advanced materials, devices, structural architectures, and platforms are being developed to allow military systems to adapt to changing mission requirements and unpredictable environments.

programs.title: Continuous-correctness On Opaque Processors (COOP)
programs.desc: The Continuous-correctness On Opaque Processors (COOP) program will validate that continuous correctness of software enables adoption of the latest processors with low overhead.

programs.title: Artificial Intelligence Cyber Challenge (AIxCC)
programs.desc: The Artificial Intelligence Cyber Challenge (AIxCC) program is developing and demonstrating techniques for automated discovery and remediation of software vulnerabilities at speed and at scale.

programs.title: Mining and Understanding Software Enclaves (MUSE)
programs.desc: The Mining and Understanding Software Enclaves (MUSE) program developed program analyses and frameworks for improving the resilience and reliability of complex software applications at scale.

programs.title: Nanoscale/Bio-inspired and MetaMaterials
programs.desc: The research in this thrust area exploits advances in nano/micro-scale and bio-inspired materials, including computationally based materials science, in order to develop unique microstructures, material properties, and functionalities.

programs.title: Guaranteed Architectures for Physical Security (GAPS)
programs.desc: The Guaranteed Architectures for Physical Security (GAPS) program developed hardware security and software architectures with provable security interfaces. These interfaces physically isolate high-risk transactions during both system design and system build, and will ensure that such protections are enforced at run-time.

programs.title: Humboldt
programs.desc: The Humboldt program seeks to develop directed energy (DE) devices to produce disruptive effects in electronic systems. The devices have potential for dual-use as sources to characterize the susceptibility of commercial electronics to electromagnetic interference (EMI).

programs.title: Technologies for Mixed-mode Ultra Scaled Integrated Circuits (T-MUSIC)
programs.desc: The Technologies for Mixed-mode Ultra Scaled Integrated Circuits (T-MUSIC) program developed an on-shore semiconductor foundry platform for very wide band radio frequency (RF) mixed-mode integrated circuit analog-to-digital converters for commercial and military systems.

programs.title: Cyber Security and Resilience Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: Efforts conducted under this thrust study and refine technologies for cyber security and resilience of U.S. software systems. Security and resilience of the software in weapon, combat, and information systems is essential for warfighters who rely on the correct functioning of this software for success on the battlefield.

programs.title: Advanced Space Technology Concepts
programs.desc: Studies conducted under this program examined and evaluated emerging technologies and concepts with the potential to provide substantial improvement in efficiency, effectiveness, and resilience of operations in space.

programs.title: Semiconductor Technology Advanced Research Network (STARNet)
programs.desc: The Semiconductor Technology Advanced Research Network (STARNet) program was a government-industry partnership designed to enable the performance requirements of future sensing, communication, computing, and memory applications.

programs.title: Rapid Healing for Warfighter Injuries
programs.desc: The Rapid Healing for Warfighter Injuries effort addressed the DoD need for improving warfighter recovery from injury by developing technologies that can accelerate the restoration and repair of complex wounds.

programs.title: Automating Scientific Knowledge Extraction and Modeling (ASKEM)
programs.desc: The Automating Scientific Knowledge Extraction and Modeling (ASKEM) program developed technologies and tools for the agile creation, sustainment, and enhancement of complex models and simulators to enable knowledge extraction and data-informed decision making in diverse scientific domains and military missions.

programs.title: Complex Hybrid Systems
programs.desc: The Complex Hybrid Systems program was focused on exploring fundamental science, mathematics, and computational approaches to collectives, complex hybrid (e.g., human-machine) systems and systems-of-systems across a variety of DoD-relevant domains.

programs.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineering and Assurance Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: Efforts conducted under this thrust study and refine artificial intelligence (AI), human-machine symbiosis (HMS), and machine learning (ML) concepts and technologies to facilitate the engineering and assurance of AI-based systems for mission-critical national security applications.

programs.title: Additive Manufacturing of MicrosystEms (AMME)
programs.desc: The Additive Manufacturing of MicrosystEms (AMME) program is revolutionizing microsystem manufacturing by leveraging selective material synthesis and 3D patterning to enable a new class of microsystems.

programs.title: Midway
programs.desc: The Midway program will develop and demonstrate a communication-based payload distributed onboard mobile platforms in order to enable long range transmission and reception capabilities.

programs.title: Resilient Supply-and-Demand Networks (RSDN)
programs.desc: The Resilient Supply-and-Demand Networks (RSDN) program is developing supply-chain risk management analytics to detect systemic challenges and improve resilience in supply and demand networks (SDN).

programs.title: Fundamentals of Nanoscale and Emergent Effects and Engineered Devices
programs.desc: The Fundamentals of Nanoscale and Emergent Effects and Engineered Devices program seeks to understand and exploit a broad range of physical properties and new physics that emerge as a result of material and/or device structure and organization at nano-scale dimensions and/or at extreme temperature and pressure.

programs.title: Cyber Operations Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: Efforts conducted under this thrust study and refine technologies to achieve decisive and enduring operational advantages in the cyber domain.

programs.title: Environmental Microbes as a Bioengineering Resource (EMBER)
programs.desc: The Environmental Microbes as a Bioengineering Resource (EMBER) program aims to develop novel, bio-based technologies to overcome key challenges facing the domestic supply of Rare Earth Elements (REEs) critical to the U.S. and DoW.

programs.title: Emerging Opportunities in Math and Computer Sciences
programs.desc: The grounds for strategic surprise are often realized through the discovery of unifying principles, novel fundamental limits, and unexpected connections between nominally disparate fields. This thrust explores emergent capabilities and universal

programs.title: Tactically Exploited Reconnaissance Node (TERN)
programs.desc: The Tactically Exploited Reconnaissance Node (TERN) program, a joint effort with the Office of Naval Research, developed a systems approach for, and perform technical demonstration of, a Medium-Altitude, Long-Endurance Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (MALE UAV) capability from smaller ships.

programs.title: DARPA Launch Challenge
programs.desc: Advances in technology, including networking and computing, have significantly increased the utility of small (<300kg) spacecraft that would previously have been of limited military value.

programs.title: SafeWare
programs.desc: The SafeWare program developed new code obfuscation techniques for protecting software from reverse engineering. At present, adversaries can extract sensitive information from stolen software, which could include cryptographic private keys, special inputs/failsafe modes, and proprietary algorithms.

programs.title: Artificial Intelligence Operations and Effects Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: Efforts conducted under this thrust study and refine artificial intelligence (AI), human-machine symbiosis, and machine learning concepts and technologies to enable a broad range of military operations and effects.

programs.title: Computational Cultural Understanding (CCU)
programs.desc: The Computational Cultural Understanding (CCU) program created cross-cultural language understanding technologies to improve a Department of Defense (DoD) operator's situational awareness and interactional effectiveness.

programs.title: Defend Against Crop System Attack
programs.desc: The Defend Against Crop System Attack program developed a platform technology aimed at increasing the speed of DoD response to state or non-state actor release of biological threats directed at our crop systems. Conventional methods

programs.title: Compact High Intensity Radiating Photonics (CHIRP)
programs.desc: The Compact High Intensity Radiating Photonics (CHIRP) program will develop compact, ultra-fast, high-power lasers. Ultra-short-pulse lasers are crucial tools for high-precision sensing and timing, novel manufacturing, and directed energy effects, but the size of these lasers limits their ability to be used on or against highly mobile pla…

programs.title: Valley Forge
programs.desc: The Valley Forge program will develop wholly new, low-cost missiles through a novel approach that enables designing, manufacturing and producing munitions at greater speed and scale. This capability augments the nation's magazine depth and provides capacity adaptability for weapons quantity demands in future conflicts.

programs.title: Open Price Exploration for National security (OPEN)
programs.desc: The Open Price Exploration for National security (OPEN) program aims to increase supply chain resilience and enable more efficient critical mineral markets by leveraging advances in artificial intelligence (AI) prediction and forecasting to increase structural price, supply, and demand transparency.

programs.title: Dynamic Optimization for Defense of Ground bases with Electromagnetic warfare (DODGEball)
programs.desc: The Dynamic Optimization for Defense of Ground bases with Electromagnetic warfare (DODGEball) program will develop algorithms for optimization of non-kinetic countermeasures for efficient and effective resource management in extended campaign warfare.

programs.title: Cora
programs.desc: The Cora program developed technologies to enable machines to read heterogeneous text-based data sources, extract key entities and activities, and characterize cyber threats. Large volumes of text-based data contain scattered clues about the activities of cyber threats.

programs.title: AdvaNced airCraft Infrastructure-Less Launch And RecoverY (ANCILLARY)
programs.desc: The AdvaNced airCraft Infrastructure-Less Launch And RecoverY (ANCILLARY) program developed and flight demonstrated an X-plane with the critical technologies required for a leap-ahead in long endurance, vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) unmanned air system (UAS) performance.

programs.title: High Operational Temperature Sensors (HOTS)
programs.desc: Many commercial, industrial, and defense systems experience thermal environments that are beyond the performance and survivability of today's physical sensors. The High Operational Temperature Sensors (HOTS) program is developing a high-performance sensor platform for operation at extreme high temperature.

programs.title: Next Generation Microelectronics - Advanced Manufacturing Science
programs.desc: Next Generation Microelectronics - Advanced Manufacturing Science addresses the fundamental science of advanced design, fabrication, packaging, assembly, and testing for complex microsystems.

programs.title: Upward Falling Payloads (UFP)

programs.desc: The Albatross program is exploring new technologies to enable perpetually flying aircraft. programs.title: Supply Chain & Logistics in Electronic Technology
programs.desc: DARPA s Supply Chain and Logistics in Electronic Technology program is developing the technologies to help ensure a robust and secure domestic supply chain for advanced microsystems. This includes the design, assembly, packaging, and testing technologies for advanced microsystems that exploits and extends beyond commercial activities.

programs.title: Autonomous Multi-domain Adaptive Swarms-of-Swarms (AMASS)
programs.desc: Autonomous Multi-domain Adaptive Swarms-of-Swarms (AMASS) builds on the successes of SESU (budgeted in this PE/Project) and on related Service programs to create a scalable, robust, and interoperable system-of-systems, capable of defeating adversary Anti-Access/Area Denial (A2/AD) capabilities at the theatre level.

programs.title: H6

programs.title: Advanced RF Mapping
programs.desc: One of the key advantages on the battlefield is the ability to actively sense and manipulate the radio frequency (RF) environment, enabling reliable and assured communications, as well as effectively mapping and manipulating the adversary's communications in ways that defy their situational awareness, understanding, or response.

programs.title: Gene Editor Enabled Diagnostics & Biosurveillance
programs.desc: The Gene Editor Enabled Diagnostics & Biosurveillance program aimed to develop fieldable, low-cost, programmable and reconfigurable diagnostic capabilities for rapid, specific, sensitive, and multiplexed detection and characterization of biological threats in military and public health scenarios.

programs.title: Intrinsic Cognitive Security (ICS)
programs.desc: The Intrinsic Cognitive Security (ICS) program is extending computational formal methods with cognitive guarantees and models to protect mixed reality (MR) users from cognitive attack.

programs.title: Environment-driven Conceptual Learning (ECOLE)
programs.desc: The Environment-driven Conceptual Learning (ECOLE) program created artificial intelligence (AI) agents capable of continually learning from linguistic and visual input to enable human-machine collaborative analysis of image, video, and multimedia documents during time-sensitive, mission-critical Department of War analytic tasks, where rel…

programs.title: Multi-Optical Sensing (MOS)
programs.desc: The proliferation of Radio Frequency (RF)-based countermeasures, such as Digital Radio Frequency Memory (DRFM), has presented challenges to the effectiveness of data sensors.

programs.title: System of Systems Architecture, Technology Development, and Demonstration
programs.desc: The System of Systems Architecture, Technology Development, and Demonstration program seeks to implement an architecture framework capable of assessing and demonstrating potential operational benefits of integrating various system capabilities to improve mission success in contested environments.

programs.title: Human-Machine Symbiosis (HMS)
programs.desc: The Human-Machine Symbiosis (HMS) program will conduct applied research to enable machines to collaborate with humans as colleagues, partners, and teammates. The world is moving faster than humans can assimilate, understand, and act.

programs.title: Bioremediation of Battlefields
programs.desc: The Bioremediation of Battlefields program addressed the DoW need to stabilize and remediate sites impacted by prior military activities, including contaminated combat zones, defense installations, and test ranges.

programs.title: Intent-Defined Adaptive Software (IDAS)
programs.desc: The Intent-Defined Adaptive Software (IDAS) program developed technologies to represent the intent of software and its abstract constraints separately from its concrete instantiation, for the purpose of enabling rapid code synthesis and continual adaptation.

programs.title: Transfer from Imprecise and Abstract Models to Autonomous Technologies (TIAMAT)
programs.desc: The Transfer from Imprecise and Abstract Models to Autonomous Technologies (TIAMAT) program is developing techniques to robustly transfer learned autonomy from fast abstract simulations to autonomous platforms in real-world environments.

programs.title: Assured Neuro Symbolic Learning and Reasoning (ANSR)
programs.desc: The Assured Neuro Symbolic Learning and Reasoning (ANSR) program is developing new hybrid artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms that deeply integrate symbolic reasoning with data driven learning to create trustworthy AI-based systems.

programs.title: Counter Adversarial Artificial Intelligence
programs.desc: The Counter Adversarial Artificial Intelligence program enhanced the capability to detect, deflect, and diminish the effects of adversarial attacks on AI-based systems. Defense systems increasingly incorporate artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities such as machine learning and automated reasoning.

programs.title: Limits of Thermal Sensors (LOTS)
programs.desc: The Limits of Thermal Sensors (LOTS) program demonstrated long-wave infrared (LWIR) detector technologies with both high performance and low size, weight, power, and cost (SWaP-C).

programs.title: Biological Undersea Energy
programs.desc: The Biological Undersea Energy program aims to develop emerging technologies that ensure the DoW has the capability to maintain a presence in austere oceanic conditions to provide advanced knowledge of resources and conditions and achieve desired mission effects.

programs.title: BioFuse
programs.desc: The BioFuse program will create disruptive biotechnologies to economically process minerals and metals without the hazardous chemical steps traditionally required. programs.title: Gene Editing Enabled Diagnostics & Biosurveillance
programs.desc: The Gene Editing Enabled Diagnostics & Biosurveillance program is developing fieldable, low-cost gene editing- based diagnostics capabilities for rapid, specific, sensitive, and multiplexed detection of biological threats in military and public health scenarios.

programs.title: Magnetic Miniaturized and Monolithically Integrated Components (M3IC)
programs.desc: The Magnetic Miniaturized and Monolithically Integrated Components (M3IC) program integrated magnetic components onto semiconductor materials, improving the size and functionality of electromagnetic (EM) systems for communications, radar, and electronic warfare (EW).

programs.title: Distributed Radar Image Formation Technology (DRIFT)
programs.desc: Based on developments in small synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites in commercial industry, there were new opportunities to experiment with novel SAR-related concepts. The Distributed Radar Image Formation Technology (DRIFT) program demonstrated advanced capabilities enabled by a cluster of SAR satellites flown in a coordinated way.

programs.title: Quantifying Uncertainty in Physical Systems
programs.desc: The Quantifying Uncertainty in Physical Systems thrust will create the basic mathematics needed to efficiently quantify, propagate and manage multiple sources of (parametric and model) uncertainty to make accurate predictions about and also design stochastic, complex DoD systems.

programs.title: Blue Wolf
programs.desc: Undersea platforms have inherent operational and tactical advantages such as stealth and surprise. Platform drag due to fluid viscosity and platform powering requirements varies with the speed through the water.

programs.title: Argus
programs.desc: The Argus program will develop novel machine learning architectures that employ models utilizing automated scoping and accelerate training efficiency to enable the creation of more generalized models across multiple sub-domains within the maritime surveillance mission.

programs.title: Cyber Grand Challenge (CGC)
programs.desc: The Cyber Grand Challenge (CGC) program created automated defenses that identified and responded to cyber attacks more rapidly than human operators. CGC technology monitored defended software and networks during operations, reasoned about flawed software, formulated effective defenses, and deployed defenses automatically.

programs.title: Planar Imager
programs.desc: The Planar Imager program evaluated the feasibility of a lightweight, compact, affordable optical payload to be integrated into a ride-share compatible satellite bus with equivalent imaging performance of current commercial conventional optical imaging satellites.

programs.title: Compact Neutron Sources
programs.desc: The Compact Neutron Sources thrust will develop the platform technologies for revolutionary portable energetic sources for in-field sensing, detection, and imaging. A focus of this thrust will be the development of compact neutron sources.

programs.title: Tactical Exploitation of the Acoustic Channel (TEAC)
programs.desc: The Tactical Exploitation of the Acoustic Channel (TEAC) program provided the capability to coherently combine acoustic energy from a distributed network of underwater acoustic sources to improve signal transmission in an undersea environment.

programs.title: Communication in Contested Environments (C2E)
programs.desc: The Communication in Contested Environments (C2E) program sought to address communications problems anticipated in networked airborne systems in the mid-21st century.

programs.title: Shosty
programs.desc: Shosty developed and demonstrated enhanced capabilities for high frequency (HF) over-the-horizon-radar (OTHR) systems. This program developed techniques to characterize distributed skywave HF radar propagation channels and measure radar backscatter from the surface.

programs.title: Securing Artificial Intelligence for Battlefield Effective Robustness (SABER)
programs.desc: The Securing Artificial Intelligence for Battlefield Effective Robustness (SABER) program aims to advance understanding of the military's use of artificial intelligence (AI) enabled systems in battlefield environments to enhance the robustness of AI-enabled systems against real-world adversarial attacks.

programs.title: Advanced Aerospace System Concepts
programs.desc: Studies conducted under this program examined and evaluated emerging aerospace technologies and system concepts for applicability to military use. This included the degree and scope of potential impact and improvements to military operations, mission utility, and warfighter capability.

programs.title: Cyber Physical systems Executing in Real time (CyPhER) Forge
programs.desc: Cyber Physical systems Executing in Real time (CyPhER) Forge will revolutionize and accelerate defense Test & Evaluation (T&E) by breaking the direct link between physical system complexity and test duration.

programs.title: Applied Microsystems Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: The Advanced Microsystems Studies and Concepts thrust will evaluate and develop burgeoning areas in microsystems design, architectures, and materials.

programs.title: Communications Module - Millimeter-wave (COMMO-MMW)
programs.desc: The Communications Module - Millimeter-wave (COMMO-MMW) program will develop a compact, scalable, millimeter wave (mm-wave) active electronically scanned array (AESA) module to enable high-performance communications links. The module will focus on low cost connectivity of weapons platforms and systems.

programs.title: Advanced Aeronautics and Space Technologies
programs.desc: The Advanced Aeronautics and Space Technologies studies examined and evaluated aeronautical and space technologies and concepts through applied research.

programs.title: Robust Quantum Sensors (RoQS)
programs.desc: The Robust Quantum Sensors (RoQS) seeks to bring quantum sensors to DoW platforms. programs.title: BioElectronics to Sense and Treat (BEST)

programs.title: Engineered Living Materials (ELM)
programs.desc: The Engineered Living Materials (ELM) program is pursuing new approaches to engineer complex biological systems for enhanced capabilities and functional materials to improve military infrastructure design and logistics, sensors, and platforms.

programs.title: Controlled Genome Protection
programs.desc: The Controlled Genome Protection program is developing advanced capabilities to control and tune the activity of gene editing technologies. Advances in synthetic biology have significantly expanded the number and types of genome editors and modulators available.

programs.title: Airborne Launch Assist Space Access (ALASA)
programs.desc: The ALASA program sought to make access to space more affordable by significantly reducing the cost of launch for <200 kg payloads to low earth orbit, with an ultimate goal of $1M for 50kg. programs.title: Knowledge Representation
programs.desc: The Knowledge Representation thrust developed much-needed tools to contextualize and analyze heterogeneous scientific data, facilitating field-wide hypothesis generation and testing.

programs.title: FLexible networking Using Intelligent Dialecting (FLUID)
programs.desc: FLexible networking Using Intelligent Dialecting (FLUID) will enable Command, Control, Computing, Communications, Cyber, Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance, and Targeting (C5ISRT) under extremely constrained internet protocol (IP) network environments, including those with link capacities in the range from 10s to single digit Kilo…

programs.title: Photonics in the Package for Extreme Scalability (PIPES)

programs.desc: The Ferroelectric Computing (FC) program will develop advanced, complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS)-compatible ferroelectric transistor, compute-in-memory element, and memory compute array technologies for critical data-intensive DoD applications such as radar processing, signal intercept and identification, and image processin…

programs.desc: The PROtein SEquencing (PROSE) program seeks to bring protein sequencing capabilities to relevant missions. A protein's sequence largely determines its structure and ultimately, its function.

programs.desc: The Air-Ground Autonomous VEhicles (AGAVE) program will explore the seams between air and ground vehicles. New approaches are required to address one of the most symmetric of all warfighting domains - ground combat.

programs.desc: Bloodstream infections (BSI) are a significant source of morbidity in service members that sustain combat-related injuries. programs.desc: The Machine Learning and Optimization-guided Compilers for Heterogeneous Architectures (MOCHA) program is developing a new generation of compiler technology that uses machine learning to automatically generate and optimize compilers that realize the full potential of heterogenous architectures.

programs.title: Probabilistic Programming for Advancing Machine Learning (PPAML)
programs.desc: The Probabilistic Programming for Advancing Machine Learning (PPAML) program created an advanced computer programming capability that greatly facilitates the construction of new machine learning applications in a wide range of domains.

programs.desc: The Artificial Intelligence Quantified (AIQ) program is developing technologies for assessing the capabilities of generative artificial intelligence (genAI) to enable mathematical guarantees on performance.

programs.desc: The Enhanced SBOM for Optimized Software Sustainment (E-BOSS) program is creating enhanced software bill of materials (eSBOM) technologies with new types of rich metadata and is developing cyber reasoning algorithms and tools that leverage eSBOMs to defend against potential flaws during the software development process and to triage and r…

programs.title: GOLDen hour extended EVACuation (GOLDEVAC)

programs.desc: Eradicating invasive species is critical to safeguarding the homeland, protecting DoW assets, and demonstrating resilience that can help deter potential adversaries.

programs.title: CoasterChase
programs.desc: DoW warfighters are often required to perform complex tasks in a high-stress situation. Warfighters under stress can make poor decisions with immediate and/or lasting consequences that may also contribute to long-term trauma.

programs.title: Restoration of Auditory and Visual Function After Injury
programs.desc: The Restoration of Auditory and Visual Function After Injury program developed neurotechnology to mitigate the effects of physical injury to the auditory and visual systems of military personnel. Research focused on understanding various forms of sensing and actuation to improve outcomes.

programs.title: All-Signal Tactical Real-Time Analyzer (ASTRAL)
programs.desc: The All-Signal Tactical Real-time Analyzer (ASTRAL) program developed and demonstrated a system for radio frequency and optical electromagnetic signal surveillance and environment understanding.

programs.title: Hybrid Multi Material Rotor Full Scale Demonstration (HyDem)
programs.desc: The goal of the Hybrid Multi Material Rotor Full Scale Demonstration (HyDem) program is to dramatically improve U.S. Navy submarine superiority.

programs.title: Enabling Production Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: The Enabling Production Studies and Concepts thrust is developing technologies that enable the production of molecules, materials, and parts in an expeditionary setting that will untether military forces from supply chains and enable a continuous global presence.

programs.title: Heterogenous Adaptively Produced Photonic Interfaces (HAPPI)
programs.desc: The Heterogeneous Adaptively Produced Photonic Interfaces (HAPPI) program aims to revolutionize information transmission within microsystems by achieving a 1000x increase in connectivity density through advanced photonic solutions.

programs.title: Automated Knowledge Acquisition (AKA)
programs.desc: The Automated Knowledge Acquisition (AKA) program will develop technologies to automate the integration of diverse sources of data and information into a unified whole. programs.title: Provably Weird Network Deployment and Detection (PWND²)
programs.desc: The Provably Weird Network Deployment and Detection (PWND²) program is developing formal models of emergent communication pathways to fundamentally improve deployment and detection of resilient hidden networks in the real world.

programs.title: Advanced Scanning Technology for Imaging Radars (ASTIR)
programs.desc: The Advanced Scanning Technology for Imaging Radars (ASTIR) program provided immediate benefit to applications that are constrained by power, weight, and the complexity limits of production.

programs.title: Native Bioelectronic Interfaces
programs.desc: The Native Bioelectronic Interfaces effort will address the DoD need for improving warfighter recovery from injury by developing technologies that can accelerate the restoration and repair of complex tissues.

programs.title: Power Efficiency Revolution For Embedded Computing Technologies (PERFECT)
programs.desc: The Power Efficiency Revolution For Embedded Computing Technologies (PERFECT) program developed low- power, specialized, resilient data processing technologies to meet the requirements of next-generation Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) systems.

programs.desc: The Harnessing Biological Systems program explored fundamental approaches to applying the advantages of nature's building blocks and principles in the design of biological technologies and systems.

programs.title: Logic Understanding for Complex Information Dissemination (LUCID)
programs.desc: The Logic Understanding for Complex Information Dissemination (LUCID) program will create artificial intelligence (AI) architectures that demonstrate that proofs encode software system knowledge to enable users to understand and adapt systems in the field without needing to be experts in software architecture or formal logic.

programs.desc: The Exponentiating Mathematics (expMath) program is developing and applying artificial intelligence (AI) techniques to enable breakthrough advances in national security-related mathematical fields.

programs.title: Complexity Management Hardware
programs.desc: The battlefield of the future will have more data generators and sensors to provide information required for successful combat operations. With networked sensors, the variety and complexity of the information streams will be even further extended.

programs.title: Signal Processing at RF (SPAR)
programs.desc: The Signal Processing at RF (SPAR) program investigated advanced analog components to process radio frequency (RF) signals for communications, radar, and electronic warfare applications.

programs.title: Gambit
programs.desc: The Gambit program will study a Rotating Detonation Engine (RDE) propulsion system design that enables standoff strike of time-critical targets from 4th generation fighters at campaign scale. This will help pave a path to a flight test of a prototype system in a future program.

programs.title: Biological Complexity (BioCom)
programs.desc: The Biological Complexity (BioCom) program sought to enhance the understanding of the basic processes associated with biological network interactions, communication, and control to enable novel approaches and technology development to improve warfighter readiness and resilience.

programs.desc: The Fostering Research and Growth in Emerging Artificial Intelligence (AI FORGE) project aims to capture and solve selected artificial intelligence (AI) research challenges to accelerate the development and fielding of frontier AI for national security.

programs.desc: The National Security Economic Theory (NASCENT) program will perpetuate a policy and market feedback loop between the United States Government (USG) and private-sector executives to support more effective geoeconomic actions with precisely defined positive national security outcomes.

programs.title: Searchlight
programs.desc: The Searchlight program developed technologies to ensure that quality-of-service (QoS) guarantees are met for distributed applications operating across the Internet. programs.desc: The Application-Tailored Artificial Intelligence (APTAI) program will develop concepts for AI capabilities whose designs and learning processes are influenced both by training data and by key concepts and features proposed by experts in the intended application domains.

programs.title: Fleetwood
programs.desc: The Fleetwood program aims to enhance the DoW's capability to produce critical materials and molecules from biomass sources, including agricultural and forestry residues. The program will explore solutions to provide the critical materials to protect, support, and sustain warfighters in austere terrestrial conditions.

programs.title: Stylized Language Processing (SLP)
programs.desc: The Stylized Language Processing (SLP) program will develop automated language processing techniques for sources that exhibit high degrees of domain-specific specialization.

programs.title: Multi-Function Optical Sensing
programs.desc: The proliferation of radio frequency (RF)-based countermeasures, such as digital radio frequency memory (DRFM), has presented challenges to the effectiveness of data sensors.

programs.title: Highly Accelerated Learnings of Vibratory Systems (HALOVS)
programs.desc: The Highly Accelerated Learning of Vibratory Systems (HALOVS) portfolio investigates the foundational limits and transformative potential of vibratory sensors for positioning and navigation in GPS-denied environments.

programs.title: Reconfigurable, Actionable, Passive Technologies for Operational Remote Sensing (RAPTORS)
programs.desc: The Reconfigurable, Actionable, Passive Technologies for Operational Remote Sensing (RAPTORS) program will enable a passive, all-optical kill chain capable of finding both stationary and moving targets with a single sensor. Sensor format can be selected based on platform requirements.

programs.title: Collection and Monitoring via Planning for Active Situational Scenarios (COMPASS)
programs.desc: The goal of the Collection and Monitoring via Planning for Active Situational Scenarios (COMPASS) program was to build decision aids for gray zone scenarios, where adversaries attempt to manipulate a U.S.-allied nation through the use of both kinetic and non-kinetic means.

programs.title: Cyber Security Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: Efforts conducted under this thrust aim to create and sustain cyber security technologies to secure the defense and civilian digital ecosystems. There is strong interest in technologies to enable tech refresh of legacy software systems using domain-specific and memory-safe languages.

programs.title: Space Surveillance Telescope (SST)
programs.desc: The Space Surveillance Telescope (SST) program has developed and demonstrated an advanced ground-based optical system to enable detection and tracking of faint objects in space, while providing rapid, wide-area search capability.

programs.title: Large Area Photocathode (LAP)

programs.title: Synthetic Hemo-technologies to Locate & Disinfect (SHIELD)
programs.desc: Bloodstream infections (BSI) are a significant source of morbidity in service members who sustain combat-related injuries. Trauma temporarily degrades the efficacy of the host immune system thereby increasing the risk of life-threating opportunistic infections from fungi and bacteria that enter into the blood.

programs.title: Wireless Autonomous Vehicle Power Transfer (WAVPT)
programs.desc: The Wireless Autonomous Vehicle Power Transfer (WAVPT) program will develop small footprint, efficient receivers to enable power beaming from a ground-based transmitter to a remote unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). UAVs are currently powered by large, heavy chemical batteries or an engine, with associated liquid fuel.

programs.title: Photonic Integrated Circuit Architectures for Scalable System Objectives (PICASSO)
Anticipatory and Adaptive Anti-money Laundering (A3ML)
programs.desc: The Anticipatory and Adaptive Anti-money Laundering (A3ML) program aims to develop graph search-based algorithms that enable anticipation of and adaptation to money laundering tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) in order to prevent money laundering in the global financial system.

programs.title: Video-rate Synthetic Aperture Radar (ViSAR)
programs.desc: Recent conflicts have demonstrated the need for close air support by precision attack platforms, such as the AC-130J aircraft, in support of ground forces. Under clear conditions, targets are easily identified and engaged quite effectively, but in degraded environments, the atmosphere can inhibit traditional optical sensors.

programs.title: Modernized Field Anesthesia
programs.desc: *Previously part of Improved Interventions The Modernized Field Anesthesia program will aim to produce safe, battlefield-ready anesthetics to reduce the trauma associated with injury and improve combat casualty outcomes.

programs.title: Frosty
programs.desc: The Frosty program will enable reliable long-range sensing in the Arctic radio frequency (RF) environment. programs.title: Alert WARfighter Enablement (AWARE)
programs.desc: The Alert WARfighter Enablement (AWARE) program is developing a combination drug and device to non-invasively increase alertness following sleep loss in humans, without negative side effects and with reduced addictive potential.

programs.title: Simulating Microbial Systems (SMS)
programs.desc: The Simulating Microbial Systems (SMS) program is developing the general capability to simulate microbial cell function and behavior to prevent strategic surprise. SMS is investigating combinations of computational advances with data acquisition techniques to advance the state of the art of cellular modeling.

programs.title: Promethean Clay
programs.desc: The Promethean Clay program will produce a new type of energy storage device boasting significantly greater capacity, broad integrability, and intrinsic safety that will overtake current technologies and allow the United States to reclaim the battery supply chain.

programs.title: Fast and Big Mixed-Signal Designs (FAB)
programs.desc: Developing capabilities to intermix and tightly integrate silicon processes which are currently supported at different scaling nodes and by different vendors is critical to increasing the capabilities of high-performance military microelectronics.

programs.title: Mobile Infantry (MI)
programs.desc: The Mobile Infantry (MI) program will explore the development of a system-based, mixed team of mounted/ dismounted warfighters, and semi-autonomous variants of platforms.

programs.title: Predicting Complex Operational Environments
programs.desc: The Predicting Complex Operational Environments program expands on prior work in the XDATA program and will develop advanced modeling, analysis, simulation, and visualization tools to enable command staffs to rapidly and effectively plan and manage missions in complex operational environments. The U.S.

programs.title: Unconventional Processing of Signals for Intelligent Data Exploitation (UPSIDE)
programs.desc: The Unconventional Processing of Signals for Intelligent Data Exploitation (UPSIDE) program created a new generation of computing structures, enabling revolutionary advances in real-time sensor data analysis.

programs.title: Medical Countermeasures
programs.desc: The Medical Countermeasures program addressed the safety and efficacy considerations in the risk/benefit package necessary to successfully counter naturally emerging or engineered biological warfare threats and new emerging chemical and radiological threats.

programs.title: Smash
programs.desc: The Smash program will develop and demonstrate highly efficient, near-zero-waste systems to process diverse raw materials and extract a wide array of elements with high purity.

programs.title: Adaptable Information Access and Control (AIAC)
programs.desc: The Adaptable Information Access and Control (AIAC) program will create the capability to dynamically, flexibly, and securely share highly selective information across enterprise boundaries. In the civilian sphere, there is a recognized need for technologies that limit the sharing of information between commercial entities and U.S.

programs.title: Protecting Cyber Physical Infrastructure (PCPI)
programs.desc: * Formerly Protecting Cyber Physical Systems (PCPS) The Protecting Cyber Physical Infrastructure (PCPI) program will create new technologies for ensuring the availability and integrity of critical U.S. cyber-physical infrastructure. The near-ubiquitous use of computers to monitor and control U.S.

programs.title: Advanced Aeronautics Technologies
programs.desc: The Advanced Aeronautics Technologies program is examining and evaluating aeronautical technologies and concepts through applied research.

programs.title: Warfighting Performance in Biomedical Technology
programs.desc: The DoD ensures force health protection by advancing technologies that sustain the operational reliability and effectiveness of the warfighter.

programs.title: IntraChip Enhanced Cooling (ICECool)
programs.desc: The IntraChip Enhanced Cooling (ICECool) program incorporated thermal management techniques directly into microelectronics. This enabled operation of military electronic systems at higher powers while significantly reducing their size and weight.

programs.title: Wireless Network Defense
programs.desc: A highly networked and enabled force increases efficiency, effectiveness, and safety by making relevant information available when it is needed and at the appropriate location (person/platform/system). Accomplishing this depends on providing reliable wireless communications to all U.S.

programs.title: Advanced Ground Technologies Concepts
programs.desc: The Advanced Ground Technologies Concepts program aimed to surmount key challenges associated with redefining access and timely delivery of effects to the ground domain by using targeted investments that explore the feasibility of novel technical solutions, force capabilities, innovations in logistics and manufacturing.

programs.title: Carbon Crunch
programs.desc: Carbon Crunch revolutionizes manufacturing for one of the longest lead time and highest risk items in the hypersonic system bill of materials: the aeroshell. Manufacturing Carbon-Carbon (C-C) composites is a slow, arduous process supported by a small, risk-intolerant industrial base, and thus not scalable to end user demands.

programs.title: Advanced Cyber Security Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: Efforts conducted under this thrust study, refine, prototype, demonstrate, and evaluate technologies for cyber security and resilience of U.S. software systems.

programs.title: Transient CBRN Threat Defense
programs.desc: *Formerly Engineering Function The Transient CBRN Threat Defense program will create a transient, near immediate prophylaxis to protect military personnel against chemical, biological, radiological, and/or nuclear (CBRN) threats.

programs.title: Emerging Opportunities in Materials Sciences
programs.desc: The grounds for strategic surprise are often realized through the discovery of unifying principles, novel fundamental limits, and unexpected connections between nominally disparate fields.

programs.title: Precision Kinetic Light Strike
programs.desc: *Formerly Precision Light Strike Munition (PLSM) The Precision Kinetic Light Strike program will seek to develop a small, lightweight, guided kinetic weapon for lightweight maneuver forces. Current short-range weapons are used against a variety of target sets using different munitions without the benefit of active guidance.

programs.title: Virtual Acoustic Microphone System (VAMS)
programs.desc: The Virtual Acoustic Microphone System (VAMS) program developed additional acoustic sensor capabilities for underwater platforms. The VAMS program sought to develop and demonstrate technologies that enable projection of underwater acoustic sensor arrays with performance comparable to existing arrays.

programs.title: Deep Thoughts
programs.desc: Deep Thoughts will expand access in the deep ocean domain by developing a new class of novel lightweight, low-cost, and rapidly designed, produced and deployed deep-ocean Autonomous Undersea Vehicles (AUVs).

programs.title: Protean
programs.desc: The acceleration of AI-based technologies has vastly expanded the opportunity space for malicious actors to rapidly discover and develop novel chemical weapons. The Protean program will develop candidate medical countermeasures (MCMs) that render entire chemical threat classes non-toxic by protecting human protein function.

programs.title: Quantitative Methods for Rapid Response (QMRR)
programs.desc: The Quantitative Methods for Rapid Response (QMRR) program develops and applies big data analysis and visualization methodologies for rapidly emergent U.S. national security priorities.

programs.title: Resilient Software Systems Capstones (RSS Capstones)

programs.desc: *Previously part of Physiological Overmatch

programs.title: Red Blood Cell Factory (RBC-Factory)
programs.desc: Warfighters operate in extreme, austere, and dangerous domains that stress physiology, contain pathogens, and compromise health and performance.

programs.title: Complex Modeling Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: The Complex Modeling Studies and Analysis thrust is exploring novel approaches to modeling and controlling physical environments in various conditions for improved platform design. Nonlinear flow conditions represent some of the oldest unsolved challenges in physics.

programs.title: Counter High Energy Lasers (C-HEL)
programs.desc: The Counter High Energy Lasers (C-HEL) program will provide a system that detects, locates and disrupts HEL adversary kill chains before irreversible damage occurs and offers survivability protection and concept of operations (CONOPS) for multi-domain U.S. assets.

programs.title: Artificial Intelligence Reliability and Traceability (AIRT)
programs.desc: The Artificial Intelligence Reliability and Traceability (AIRT) program will develop design-time and run-time technologies to ensure the correct functioning of AI-enabled systems.

programs.title: Awareness in Joint Warfighting Technology
programs.desc: The Awareness in Joint Warfighting Technology thrust will develop and demonstrate advanced technologies to project power and identify and deliver capabilities in deeply denied areas. Future joint warfighting will rely increasingly on autonomy and explore new environments and domains.

programs.title: Heterogeneous Architectures for Quantum (HARQ)
programs.desc: The Heterogeneous Architectures for Quantum (HARQ) program aims to demonstrate the scaling advantages of heterogeneous architectures for quantum computers. Large-scale quantum computers have long been lauded as a potentially revolutionary capability.

programs.title: PDUE: Autonomous Building Search Persistent Deterrence in Urban Environments
programs.desc: *Formerly part of Urban Operations The goal of the PDUE: Autonomous Building Search Persistent Deterrence in Urban Environments program is to generate capabilities which would allow distributed forces to operate effectively in dense urban areas (e.g. megacities).

programs.title: Science of Human and Computer Teaming
programs.desc: The Science of Human and Computer Teaming program will develop and demonstrate data-driven approaches for the formation and training of teams comprised of humans and computers.

programs.title: Advanced Cyber Operations Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: Efforts conducted under this thrust study, refine, prototype, demonstrate, and evaluate technologies to achieve decisive and enduring operational advantages in the cyber domain.

programs.title: Next Generation Electronic Surveillance Technology (NGEST)
programs.desc: The Next Generation Electronic Surveillance Technology (NGEST) program is creating a new Radio Frequency (RF) surveillance system for sensing in complex signal environments. NGEST is defining a new surveillance paradigm to find critical signals of interest in tactically relevant timelines.

programs.title: Mission-oriented Resilient Clouds (MRC)
programs.desc: The Mission-oriented Resilient Clouds (MRC) program created technologies to enable cloud computing systems to survive and operate through cyber attacks. Vulnerabilities found in current standalone and networked systems can be amplified in cloud computing environments.

programs.title: Emerging Opportunities in Electronic Sciences
programs.desc: The Emerging Opportunities in Electronic Sciences thrust is investing in fundamental technologies to take advantage of novel microscale phenomena.

programs.desc: The M-STUDIO program will realize a universal defect-free heterogeneous integration methodology, informed by emerging nano-scale material growth with surface free-energy driven defect termination and non-thermal-equilibrium synthesis, to achieve defect-free multi-layer heterogeneous materials with nanometer dimensions and atomically sharp…

programs.title: Advanced Cyber Systems Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: Efforts conducted under this thrust study and refine emerging opportunities and concepts in cyber systems, cyber security, and cyber operations. Cyber is now ubiquitous to warfighting.

programs.title: Rapunzel
programs.desc: Urban combat demands that riflemen also serve as combat engineers manipulating their local environment to gain tactical advantage. The urban environment creates unique challenges in providing solutions for mobility, counter-mobility, survivability, and concealment.

programs.title: Reengineering Enabling Sleep Transition in Operationally Restrictive Environments (RESTORE)
programs.desc: The Reengineering Enabling Sleep Transition in Operationally Restrictive Environments (RESTORE) program aims to enhance the efficiency of sleep to optimize warfighter performance following sleep restriction, as commonly occurs in combat operations.

programs.title: Network of Optimal Dynamic Energy Signatures (NODES)
programs.desc: Proteins are essential building blocks of life, playing a crucial role in countless biological processes. The universality of proteins across all lifeforms makes them a powerful tool in medicine, where their unique properties can be harnessed to develop life-saving therapies.

programs.title: Medics Autonomously Stopping Hemorrhage (MASH)
programs.desc: In large-scale combat operations, the inability to rapidly provide damage control surgery and lifesaving intervention results in preventable warfighter casualties.

programs.title: Active Cyber Defense (ACD)
programs.desc: The Active Cyber Defense (ACD) program developed technologies to enable DoD cyber operators to leverage inherent home field advantage when defending the DoD cyber battlespace. In the cyber environment, defenders have detailed knowledge of, and unlimited access to, the system resources that attackers wish to gain.

programs.title: Rapid Experimental Missionized Autonomy (REMA)
programs.desc: Commercial-quality drones demonstrate surprising usefulness on the modern battlefield. Rapid Experimental Missionized Autonomy (REMA) will enhance commercially available and stock military drones with a subsystem to enable autonomous operation.

programs.title: Disruptive Sensing Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: Efforts in the Disruptive Sensing and Analysis thrust examine and develop opportunities to increase our understanding of adversarial systems and through improved processing techniques, models, and signals of opportunity that will generate low-cost, actionable solutions for enhanced detection and characterization of events and systems of i…

programs.title: Dense Electronic Packaging for Heterogeneous Integration (DELPHI)
programs.desc: The Dense Electronic Packaging for Heterogeneous Integration (DELPHI) program will address the inherent limits of conventional two-dimensional (2D) electronics.

programs.title: Making, Maintaining, Supply Chains and Logistics Studies and Concepts

programs.title: Dynamic Airspace Control
programs.desc: The Dynamic Airspace Control program will develop and demonstrate alternate means of creating the local airspace picture and dynamically managing the local airspace without requiring high power radars or communications.

programs.title: Emerging Opportunities in Modeling Basic Operational Medical Science
programs.desc: The DoD will accelerate discovery and development by leveraging recent advances in computational methods to identify new capabilities and address evolving stressors encountered by warfighters.

programs.title: In The Moment (ITM)
programs.desc: In the Moment (ITM) supports the development of algorithms that are trusted to make decisions independently in difficult domains. Military operations, such as mass casualty triage, and disaster relief require complex and rapid decision-making in dynamic situations where there is often no human consensus and no ground truth.

programs.title: Artificial Intelligence and Human-Machine Symbiosis Studies and Concepts
programs.desc: Efforts conducted under this thrust aim to study and refine emerging opportunities and concepts in artificial intelligence (AI) and human machine symbiosis. AI has tremendous implications for warfighting.
